answer: Brilliant Lode (GSQ site 38722): what might remain today, from official services and registers checked on 2026-11-23; each record carries its source, the query URL and the check time. Resources: 6 records, each a modern reported resource (JORC/as published), not historical production and not a claim about what remains: Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Project) Gold as at 2020-12-09 (JORC code 2012): probable reserve 2.5 Mt at 7.7 g/t, about 618,902 troy ounces contained (derived); indicated resource 3.2 Mt at 7.7 g/t, about 792,194 troy ounces contained (derived); inferred resource 32 Mt at 14 g/t, about 14,403,534 troy ounces contained (derived) | Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Underground) Gold as at 2003-06-30 (JORC code): probable reserve 126 kt at 6.6 g/t, about 26,737 troy ounces contained (derived); indicated resource 224 kt at 7.5 g/t, about 54,013 troy ounces contained (derived) | Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Open Pit) Gold as at 2003-06-30 (JORC code): indicated resource 95 kt at 3.6 g/t, about 10,996 troy ounces contained (derived) | Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Tailings) Gold as at 1998-06-30 (JORC code): measured resource 145 kt at 2.4 g/t, about 11,188 troy ounces contained (derived). Note: resources: Merriland (ENO 333457, 0.1 km, location accuracy 999 m); Charters Towers (ENO 334170, 0.4 km, location accuracy 2000 m); 23 resource records across all reporting dates, the latest per zone and commodity listed (6); earlier reporting dates are not listed. These records show what has been drilled, reported, mapped or registered near the site. They are not an estimate of gold remaining and say nothing about whether any deposit is economic; that needs a geologist. Modern reported resources are kept apart from historical production.
